samir: Quick RFC follow-up: propose 'stability hysteresis' rules to avoid flip-flop for auto fallbacks. Sketch below, want gut-checks.

hannah: Love it. Key idea = require two independent windows before reversing a decision: a suppression window after a decision and a stability window before allowing the opposite action.

samir: Exactly. My sketch: after any applied switch, start suppress_until = now + suppress_s (default 300s). During suppress window ignore opposite switches. Then require stability_window (default 1200s) of scores below UNFLIP_THRESHOLD before switching back.

kevin: Add metric names so SRE can alert: fallback.suppress.active, fallback.unflip_hits, fallback.unflip_attempts, fallback.decision.cache_hit. Use dot notation.

hannah: Agree. Also add an emitted field in decision events: suppression_expires_at and unflip_eligibility_ts. Keep payload flat.

samir: Payload example (flat keys): decision_id, service, route, trigger_ts, evaluated_at, ttl_s, action, target, provenance, decision_state, attempt, trace_id, request_hash, suppression_expires_at, unflip_eligibility_ts, signals="latency_p95=1200;err_pct=2.1;quality_delta=-0.03"

kevin: Nice. For cache keys use service|route|action|target. Emit fallback.cache.hit/miss/eviction. LRU per-service.

hannah: For operator runbook (short):
1) On alert -> open decision panel; find decision_id.
2) Check suppression_expires_at and unflip_eligibility_ts. If within suppression, don't reverse.
3) If decision stuck executing > 90s -> POST /ops/decisions/{decision_id}/extend {"extend_seconds":300}.
4) If aborts > 2 in 15m -> disable detector and run manual canary at 5% for 30m.

kevin: Manual override snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"action":"pin","target":"model-2026-06-01"}' https://ops-api.internal.redwood/internal/decisions/dec-4321000000/override
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging canary policy updated: suppress_s=300, stability_window_s=1200, graceful_drain_s=90.

samir: One safety note: decision processors must be idempotent by decision_id and write to append-only decisions stream. Replays should not re-apply.

hannah: Telemetry contract: include trace_id and trace_url if available, hashed request_sample only, no raw PII. Register metrics in metrics.yaml.

kevin: I'll add emitter unit tests to ban runtime metric name assembly and validate exact metric strings. hannah, you want to own dashboard panels/alerts?

hannah: Yep, I'll draft alert thresholds and panels. Samir I'll wait for your PR to link. Thanks :thumbsup:
